The official Vercel docs put Pro at a **$20/month platform fee**, not a flat $20 per user. The fee includes one deploying seat and $20 in monthly usage credit, per the platform fee, a fixed monthly fee that includes $20 in usage credit. $20/month Pro platform fee, 1 deploying team seat included. The Vercel pricing table lists $20 / month per additional paid seat, and viewer seats are free.

Several third-party sites still describe Pro as "$20 per user per month." That is likely outdated: Vercel's docs say teams created on or after September 9, 2025, will be on this pricing model automatically, and teams on the legacy Pro plan are still supported, but will be moved to the new pricing model later this year.

Usage beyond the included allowances is billed on top of the fee. The docs say each Pro plan includes 1 TB Fast Data Transfer and 10,000,000 Edge Requests per month. Once those are exceeded, usage draws on the $20 credit before on-demand billing applies.

Sources: vercel.com/docs/plans/pro-plan and docs.vercel.com/docs/pricing are the most authoritative. Prices change, so confirm at vercel.com/pricing before budgeting.

content.text:
Vercel's Pro plan is **$20/month**, according to Vercel's docs.

- **Platform fee:** The $20/month fee includes one deploying seat and $20 of monthly usage credit.
- **Extra seats:** Each additional paid seat costs $20/month. Viewer seats are free.
- **Included usage:** Each month includes 1 TB of Fast Data Transfer and 10,000,000 Edge Requests. Usage beyond that draws on the $20 credit first, then is billed on-demand.
- **Older descriptions:** Many third-party sites still say "$20 per user per month". That is likely the legacy model. Teams created on or after September 9, 2025 are on the new model automatically. Legacy Pro teams are still supported but are due to be moved to it.
